subject.title: fix(agents): guard CLI MCP resume reuse

question: After the current-main result-shape repair, should OpenClaw reset strict CLI MCP resume-hash bindings when the current run cannot provide matching resume-hash proof?
rationale: This is a small correctness fix, but it intentionally changes persisted session reuse for existing users and green helper tests do not settle that session-state compatibility choice.

options.title: Accept strict reset after repair
options.body: Land the narrow guard once it returns the current `{ mode: "invalidate", invalidatedReason: "mcp" }` shape, the test is updated, and exact-head checks are green.

options.title: Request higher-level proof
options.body: Ask for `prepareCliRunContext`-level proof if maintainers want validation above the helper before accepting the one-time session reset behavior.

options.title: Hold for lifecycle policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the one-sided hash case decided with the broader stale CLI binding lifecycle work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84593.

recommendation.title: Accept strict reset after repair
recommendation.body: Land the narrow guard once it returns the current `{ mode: "invalidate", invalidatedReason: "mcp" }` shape, the test is updated, and exact-head checks are green.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent changes point to this person as the closest current owner for the helper shape and adjacent session behavior.
